layout.notebook_first:
All systems are green. The engines only need the captain's card. The captain went down to the engine room and never came back.
If you are reading this, the coolant valve got you off the bridge too. What you carry decides where a door leads.

notes.text: Looked everywhere for the gyroscope. It was never there until I picked up the dog tag.
This loop only lets go of those who carry the dog tag.
The rubber duck only shows up for someone carrying the dog tag and the gyroscope.
You won't find the rubber duck unless you carry the dog tag and the gyroscope. Don't ask me how I know.
The engine room answers to three things: the dog tag, the gyroscope and the rubber duck. Keep the notebook. The coolant valve has done its job. Let it go.

Carried the fuse through a dozen doors. Nothing changed. Drop it.
Tried the dog tag together with the pressure gauge. Bad room. Don't.
